about: Everything the preview scene is built from, in one file. 'from' says whose numbers they are: mustafa = his decision; art-lead = the Art lead's sheets (Sheet 15, 16, 17) or the instruction of 2026-11-14; board-v7 = the VFX drawing board v7; assumed = Shamble VFX's guess. Sizes in metres, line widths in px on a 1080p screen.

camera.note: The repo's camera style 3 as the drawing board draws it: 35.3 degrees above the ground, 15 degree lens (vertical), turned 45 degrees. 100.7 px per metre at 1080p (the board's reading of a 1.8 m soldier at 148 px).

light.note: Sheet 17: sun colour and shadow colour. Lit = base x sun, shade = base x shadow. Faces turned from the sun x 0.72 (board v7).
light.sunFromCameraNote: board v7: a shadow falls 0.75 m right and 0.22 m up the screen per metre of height

ground.note: Sheet 17 palette A, street: base, in the sun, in shade. The instruction's preview ground is the sunlit street.

shadeBand.note: a flat band of shadow, as cast by a building off screen, so effects are judged in sun and in shade

lines.note: Sheet 17, the line rule (px at 1080p): units outline 4.8, inside 2.1; buildings and walls outline 3.6, edges 2.6.

wall.note: Sheet 17, wall for cover: 3.1 m long, 0.45 m thick, 1.0 m high; stone of palette A.

standIn.note: Sheet 16, the Conscript as a stand-in: one soldier built from simple shapes. 1.80 m to the top of the hat is the Art lead's placeholder. Heights from the ground, widths across the body.

materials.note: Sheet 15 and 16: coat, top and trim per faction are Mustafa's decisions (Empire: coat B, the white coat, picked; Empire trim is the Art lead's); Dark is the Art lead's.

assumed.note: Not on the sheet, worked out by Shamble VFX for the 3D blockout: leg and arm thickness, hat size, how the rifle is held, muzzle position.
